source: User reports computer slept and has now resumed; exact sleep interval pending OS-log check.
chi512_timeout_interpretation: Hard wall timeout overlaps host suspension. The nominal600s soft limit preceded clamshell sleep, so the failure cannot be attributed exclusively to sleep. Last saved2-sweep Delta_S was above tolerance; final convergence unavailable. Retain executed_incomplete rather than physical exclusion.
idle_sleep_prevention: Temporary caffeinate -i -t29400; does not change system settings or prevent explicit user sleep; stop at task end.
timing_caveat: Per-run elapsed seconds overlapping this window can include host suspension/dark wake. Do not infer method CPU efficiency from these durations. No speculative exact active-CPU subtraction.
current_pmset_therm: No thermal/performance warning level or CPU power status recorded by pmset -g therm; this is not a measured temperature.
